about_short_description.short_description: HyperDX is a SAAS company that offers simple workflows that assit engineers in resolving production bugs quicker.

product.name: HyperDX Observability Platform
product.description: A cloud-native observability platform that unifies logs, traces, metrics, errors, and session replays to assist engineers in debugging production issues.

product.name: Log Patterns Clustering
product.description: Automatically clusters and aggregates similar log events to identify patterns and trends in large volumes of log data.

product.name: Session Replay Correlation
product.description: Links user session replays with backend logs and traces to provide a comprehensive view of user interactions and system behavior.

product.name: High-Performance Search and Visualization
product.description: Enables fast querying and charting of observability data using an intuitive interface without requiring complex query languages.

product.name: OpenTelemetry Integration and Instrumentation
product.description: Supports vendor-neutral instrumentation and telemetry collection using OpenTelemetry standards for logs, metrics, and traces.

product.name: Alerting and Notification System
product.description: Allows users to create alerts on metrics and log patterns with notifications via Slack, Email, PagerDuty, and other integrations.
